content.text:
Yes, this is really common at 20 months. Sleep often gets bumpy around now with teething, big developmental jumps, or a nap or bedtime that has drifted.

Tonight, keep the 2am visit boring. Go in, keep the lights off and your voice low, give a quick pat or a few calm words, and leave before they're fully worked up. Skip the bottle, the play and the cuddle on the couch, so 2am doesn't turn into an event they start waking for.
